name: base-promo
description: The BASE 90-second promo video, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render BasePromo out/base-promo.mp4 --gl=angle
scripts.render:cpu: npm run audio && remotion render BasePromo out/base-promo.mp4 --gl=swangle
scripts.render:draft: npm run audio && remotion render BasePromoDraft out/base-promo-draft.mp4 --scale=0.5
